claims.head: Don’t buy Vasilevskiy’s record against the Islanders
claims.body: Vasilevskiy has been a wall against the Islanders since 2023-24, well above his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if Vasilevskiy isn’t that wall tonight.
claims.nums: 5 starts against NY Islanders: .940 save percentage · .910 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Vasilevskiy’s record against the Islanders.
claims.call: If Vasilevskiy starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .910 than to his .940 against the Islanders.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 5 against NY Islanders, 4,588 shots against everyone else

Vasilevskiy: .910 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 4,588 shots.

claims.head: Expect the Lightning to have the puck more
claims.body: At 5-on-5, the Lightning have been one of the league’s best at getting more of the chances than they give up, and the Islanders around the middle. The ice should tilt the Lightning’s way, even if goaltending and bounces have the final say on the score.

NYI.head: The Islanders face a real test
NYI.body: Even though the Islanders have home-ice advantage, Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Islanders can pull it off if they get good looks.

TBL.body: Even though the Islanders have home-ice advantage, Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Islanders’ way back in is getting good looks.

items.text: The Lightning are newly without Emil Lilleberg, and have had to make do without Yanni Gourde all season.
The Islanders have been without Mathew Barzal all season. Counting how much each missing player usually brings, only the Kings are missing more right now.
